auth.otpHint: Enter the code from your email.
auth.timeout: That took too long. Try again.

home.cta: Write a world, open a table, or sit down with friends.
home.pitch: The Storyteller speaks the tale. You choose what to do. The table keeps the score.
home.hostLead: Pick one of your worlds and open a room.
home.playLead: Browse open tables. Public rooms let you sit down at once. Private rooms ask for a password.
home.universeLead: Name the world, set the age and mood, then invite the people who live there.
home.downloadLead: Prefer the desktop app? Pick your platform and download Tale Role for Windows or Mac.

admin.title: Spectator console
admin.hint: You join every room invisibly. Players never see this seat.
admin.lead: Sign in with the spectator email. Players never see this origin.
admin.tracesHint: Live traces refresh every 4s. Mechanic JSON stays off the player table. Next turn uses the pack text below.

table.statHint: Six traits, 1–6 each. Spend 18 points in total.
table.saveFailed: Could not save the character. Refresh and try again.
table.saveBadStats: Spend exactly 18 trait points (1–6 each) and pick three skills.
table.saveAlreadySeated: This account already has a seat. Sign in with the other account.
table.saveSpectator: This account is the system admin. It watches the table invisibly and cannot take a player seat. Sign the second person in with a separate player account.
table.saveNeedLogin: There is no session. Sign in again on the second device with a player account.
table.initHint: Each player rolls once. Highest sits first.
table.awaitInit: Waiting for everyone to roll for seating.
table.taleEnded: The tale is told. Lantern standing waits for the next table.
table.waitTurn: Wait for your turn. The table is quiet until then.
table.notes: What do you do or ask?
table.sceneStub: A lantern sketch of the scene.
table.waiting: The lanterns hold. Speak, pass, or wait.
table.awaitStart: Waiting for the host to begin.
table.awaitSheet: Write who you are. Spend 18 on traits. Mark three skills.
table.speciesHint: Elf, human, construct — however this world names you.
table.backstoryHint: A wound, a debt, a home. Leave blank and it stays untold.
table.skillsHint: Mark three. Those add to the roll.
table.loadError: Could not open this table. Sign in, then try again.
table.actionError: The table did not take that.
table.joinForbidden: Could not sit down. Check the password, or that you are signed in.

lobby.title: Lobbies
lobby.lead: Open tables wait below. Pick one, or join with an invite.
lobby.empty: No tables yet. Host one, or wait for a friend.
lobby.inviteHint: Paste a room code from a friend.

universe.title: Your world
universe.lead: Give it a name, an age, a mood — then the people who live there.
universe.name: Name
universe.nameHint: What do travelers call this place?
universe.eraHint: When is this? First winter, a dying empire, a far colony…
universe.toneHint: How should it feel? Warm, grim, sly, mournful…
universe.lookHint: This paints the lantern and the table.
universe.storyHint: Lands, history, what is at stake. Write as if you were telling a friend.
universe.openingHint: Where do the players wake? Leave blank and the Storyteller will open.
universe.npcLead: Who lives here? Add as many as you like. If you skip the details, they will fit themselves to the tale.
universe.npcDetailHint: Clan, duty, secret, what they want. Leave blank and they adapt.
universe.review: This is the world you will host.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Your rights on this instance (KVKK / GDPR).
privacy.storeBody: Email, a hashed password, optional device license, tables and characters you create, worlds you write. Hosted play stores this in our database. You can export or erase it.
privacy.llmBody: The tale is told on our machines. We do not send your play to paid outside story models. Player logs are not training data.
privacy.rightsBody: Download a copy of your record. Erase the account. After erase, you are signed out.
privacy.notBody: Not a law-firm letter. Operators keep production secrets out of the public repo.

account.title: Your account
account.lead: Export or erase. Erase cannot be undone here.
account.needSignIn: Sign in to manage your data.
account.totpOn: Two-step sign-in is on. After your password, the app asks for a code.
account.totpOff: Optional second step. Scan the code, then confirm.
account.totpScan: Scan this with Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator.
account.totpManual: No camera? Copy the secret, then Add account → Enter a setup key.
account.totpSecretHint: Add this secret in your authenticator. We never email it.
account.desktopOnly: Open the desktop app to register this machine.
account.lanternHint: Your standing at every table. It never changes the dice in a world.
account.prefsHint: Look, language, and sign out live here.
account.portraitHint: Pick a painted likeness. It follows you to every table.
